title: PNG vs WebP: Which Format Should You Choose?
description: Compare PNG and WebP for image quality, transparency, compression, and web performance so you can choose the best format for your workflow.
author: Converigo
seo_keywords: which is better png or webp

sections.title: PNG vs WebP at a Glance
sections.content: PNG and WebP both support high-quality images, but they are optimized for different use cases. PNG is widely trusted for transparent graphics, editing workflows, and compatibility. WebP is designed for modern web delivery and often gives smaller files with similar visual quality.

sections.title: Performance and File Size
sections.content: WebP often delivers smaller files than PNG for photographic or simplified graphics, which can improve page speed and reduce bandwidth use. PNG remains strong when precise quality preservation and transparency are more important than absolute file size.

sections.title: Transparency Support
sections.content: PNG has long been the standard for alpha transparency. WebP also supports transparency, but browser and tool support can still vary across older workflows. For broad compatibility, PNG remains a safe choice.

faq.question: Is WebP better than PNG?
faq.answer: WebP is often better for file size and web performance, while PNG is better when compatibility and transparency quality are the priority.

faq.question: Should I convert PNG to WebP?
faq.answer: If you need smaller web files and browser support is acceptable, converting PNG to WebP can be a good option.
